description: Nexus Verge cultures — defined by when someone arrived and why they stayed, not by race (see docs/world/PEOPLES.md). Collectively these peoples are called 'the Wrought' (see docs/world/PEOPLES.md and docs/world/CREATURES.md). Used by NPCGenerator to pick a culture-flavoured name pool for procedural NPCs, independent of mechanical race in races.json. npcWeight reflects PEOPLES.md 'Writing Across Cultures': Kethara are the majority in any mixed settlement; Vaethori hold a significant administrative/military presence; Verathi, Delhari, and Sirathi are minorities; Vethri are rare outside void-adjacent settlements.

cultures.name: Kethara
cultures.etymology: The Settled — 2-5 generations in, descendants of early arrivals who stopped being from somewhere else

cultures.name: Vaethori
cultures.etymology: Citizens of Vaethora — the colonial empire that built the roads, keeps the census, and maintains the forts

cultures.name: Verathi
cultures.etymology: Old Blood — the oldest inhabitants; philosopher-citizens who govern each threshold settlement by its own Convocation, stewards of Aevorn rather than owners of it

cultures.name: Delhari
cultures.etymology: The Arrivals — here deliberately, in the last generation, for something specific

cultures.name: Sirathi
cultures.etymology: The Unmoored — void refugees whose home regions have been consumed or are going

cultures.name: Vethri
cultures.etymology: The Silent — settled at or near the Void boundary, calibrated rather than corrupted
